identity: Deep dark olive-brown shaggy warg with muted warm ochre patches and scar-like cross marks, two pointed triangular ears, a short sequence of small pointed golden spikes on the forehead and longer golden spikes along its back. Broad dark brown canine nose and muzzle, amber-yellow eyes with small black pupils, heavy dark brows, large ivory fangs and teeth, ochre mouth accents. Four sturdy canine legs with rounded paws and subtle toe divisions, one long broad curved dark brown shaggy tail. No saddle, collar, armor, rider, wings or invented organs.
up_finding: Rear head is faceless, but front-facing gold ear pads and forward toe divisions remain visible. Preserve raw; locally revise ear interiors to outer-ear fur and paws to plain rear heels before stage. Head crown spikes and dorsal spikes are present in its own original atlas and remain.
